verdict.rationale: Extend publishes a structured API reference with per-endpoint pages for authentication and file upload, plus an API quickstart that walks through installing the SDK and parsing a document. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive (no try-it console or playground) or that its examples can be run in-browser. Missing for 10: an interactive API explorer, runnable in-reference examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
